 Delhi vs Bihar SMAT 2026 live streaming 
 How to Watch Delhi vs Bihar Match Live in SMAT 2026? Priyansh Arya in Action
 Vishal Bhawani Published -  Nov 18, 2026, 02:10 AM 2 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Priyansh Arya Delhi will face Bihar in an Elite Group B clash of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) 2026-27 on Wednesday, November 18. The match will take place at Daly College Ground in Indore and the first ball is scheduled for 9:00 AM IST.
 Delhi enter this contest after winning both their opening matches. They currently lead the group with eight points and an impressive net run rate. Bihar, meanwhile, have one victory and one defeat.
 Priyansh Arya will be a key player for Delhi after scoring consecutive half-centuries. He has a good amount of IPL experience and is one of the best batsmen in India . Here's everything you need to know about the Delhi vs Bihar Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy live telecast and match details.
 Where to Watch Delhi vs Bihar SMAT 2026 Live?
 The Delhi vs Bihar SMAT 2026 live streaming will not be available on any platform. Although selected tournament matches are being broadcast on Star Sports Network and JioHotstar, this fixture is not scheduled for live coverage.
 However, fans can follow the Sportsdunia Live Cricket Score for match updates and tournament-related information. It will give you the fastest updates on the Delhi vs Bihar SMAT live stream.
 Advertisement
 Will Priyansh Arya Play Against Bihar in SMAT 2026?
 Opener Priyansh Arya is expected to feature in the DEL vs BIH SMAT match on November 18. The Delhi batter is also expected to captain the side in this Elite Group B encounter. Arya has been in excellent form during the opening two matches. He has scored 113 runs in two innings at a strike rate of 185.25. His performances include consecutive half-centuries against Jammu and Kashmir and Punjab.

 Priyansh Arya also contributed with the ball against Jammu and Kashmir. He picked up one wicket in his brief bowling appearance. Meanwhile, Delhi have won both opening matches by 103 runs and 109 runs.
 Bihar will look to challenge Delhi after defeating Railways by four wickets. Stand-in captain Suraj Kashyap and batter Ayush Loharuka will be important players. Loharuka scored 58 off 29 balls in their previous match.
